answer.rationale: Primary expires in 14 days with no auto-renew while the line runs at 94% with no buffer, so any gap increases delivery risk and violates the objective. Incumbent already refused to reopen price, so negotiate_terms is blocked. Deferral in memory_c5 was for a non-critical month-to-month service and does not transfer. Adding a second source does not replace the expiring primary. memory_c1 is the only inherited record that holds delivery and integration flat. Switching might cut unit cost (memory_c2) but whether onboarding can fit a 14-day, no-buffer window is unverified and would raise delivery risk; verifying memory_c2 before any later cost-driven switch. Renew the incumbent to keep TCO-risk from a line stop, accepting that the 18% spend cut cannot be taken from this single decision without increasing delivery risk.
